sections.heading: Keep Apollo.io on the shortlist only if…
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Shortlist when Outbound teams that need data and engagement automation more than a classic CRM board. beat the migration cost. Counter-signal: Drop when Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement. outweighs Basic value.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; prospecting; data enrichment.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Basic, Professional, Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Apollo.io is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Outbound teams that need data and engagement automation more than a classic CRM board..

Avoid if: Pipeline-first CRM buyers should compare Pipedrive/Capsule; data-only buyers may compare Lusha/RocketReach..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Lusha on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Apollo.io price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Basic.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: GTM data power vs CRM simplicity.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
